text: Aaron Gordon was given a double technical in the fourth quarter against Golden State on Oct. 26 and exited the court. He had seven points. He played 25 minutes.
Aaron Gordon played 30 minutes but had only 3 points and 5 rebounds on poor shooting. The show said his body does not look like it is cooperating and that he is 168th in fantasy this season.
Gordon had nine points in 27 minutes as a starter. The show said his usage rate has dropped and he has fallen off this season.
Aaron Nesmith returned to the starting lineup Wednesday at Memphis and scored 16 points in 30 minutes, including the late three that sealed the win.
Aaron Nesmith averaged about 24 minutes, 13 points and one steal over his last seven games. The show said minutes limits have held him back, but he played 30 minutes in each of his last two games.

Nesmith has played about 30 minutes a game over the last week with Tyrese Haliburton out, including 34 minutes with 18 points and four threes on Nov. 9. The show said his shot volume is up to almost 14 a game in that stretch, but his field goal percentage is only around 38 percent. The show said his usage will drop when Haliburton returns.

Aaron Nesmith is questionable for Nov 13 with right knee soreness. The show called him Indiana's best perimeter defender and said Jalen Brunson and the Knicks look better if he sits, with about 30 minutes to redistribute. He started and played 22 minutes on Nov 11.

Aaron Wiggins played 29 minutes off the bench on November 6 and scored 19 points with 3 threes. The show said he bounces between a low-end starter and a streamer, and it noted that Atlanta is entering a very light stretch of its schedule.
Aaron Wiggins scored 15 points with 4 threes in 23 minutes off the bench. The show said he is now sharing bench touches with CJ McCollum and has low upside.

Ace Bailey remains a Utah starter, but his recent production has dipped with 20.0 and 21.5 DraftKings points in his last two games. The show said his role could shrink further once Lauri Markkanen and especially Jaren Jackson Jr. are both back.
Ace Bailey started and played 32 minutes on Nov 8 but scored only 7 points, with 4 steals saving his line. The show said he is only a must-roster player because of Utah's injuries.

Ace Bailey has been starting and playing heavy minutes with Jaren Jackson Jr. out since 10/26, including 35 minutes on 11/10. He broke out for 23 points, 7 rebounds and 3 threes on 11/10. The show said his minutes are high enough to expect spike games, but that his production will bounce around until Jackson returns.
Ace Bailey has started every recent game and played 32 minutes on Nov. 8. The show said he should see more shots with Keyonte George and Jaren Jackson Jr. out and Lauri Markkanen possibly out.

Ace Bailey has started and played 32, 35 and 31 minutes over Utah's last three games with Markkanen out. He scored 42.25 DraftKings points on Nov. 11, and the show said he has a real role and will play a ton of minutes.
Bailey had 18 points, seven rebounds, two steals and four blocks in 31 minutes. The show said he can be played until Jaren Jackson Jr. returns, and that George's return will hurt him a little.

Aday Mara started and played 27 minutes on November 7, posting 18 points, 8 rebounds and 3 blocks, after playing 18 minutes off the bench on November 6. The show said that since Chet Holmgren went down it expects Mara to average around 22 to 23 minutes, and it noted the Thunder's center rotation is hard to predict game to game.

With Chet Holmgren out, Mara has averaged about 24 minutes, 10.5 points, eight rebounds, and 2.2 blocks from Oct. 29 through Nov. 10, and he started on Nov. 4, Nov. 7, and Nov. 11. The show said his role will likely shrink when Jaylin Williams returns, noting he played 20 minutes on Nov. 2 when Williams started.

Aday Mara played 26 minutes off the bench on November 10 and had 10 points, 10 rebounds and 1 block. The show said his floor is safe enough to roster him for rebounds and blocks, though he offers little in other categories.

Aday Mara moved into the starting lineup and played 32 minutes with 11 points, six rebounds, and a block. The show said his production was average and he will lose minutes when Ajay Mitchell and Jalen Williams return.
The show said AJ Dybantsa is off his minutes restriction. He has played 30, 33 and 32 minutes in his last three games.
AJ Dybantsa had 21 points, 8 rebounds and 2 blocks in 37 minutes. The show said he is getting a lot of minutes and decent usage, but he gives little in assists and steals.

The show said AJ Dybantsa is a tough play at $6,600 because he shares the scoring load with Kyshawn George, Anthony Davis and Trae Young. Dybantsa had 13 points and 23.5 DK points in 34 minutes on Nov 11.
AJ Dybantsa played 44 minutes Thursday against Detroit and hit the late midrange shot that forced a second overtime, but he finished with only five points and eight rebounds.

Green has played 20 to 24 minutes off the bench in each of Milwaukee's last four games. Gary Trent Jr. has played only once in that stretch, for 6 minutes on Oct 31. The show said Green is mainly a three-point source.
Ajay Mitchell scored 35 points in 30 minutes on November 6. The show said he is set for a big run with Oklahoma City dealing with long-term injuries, which include Chet Holmgren's 8-10 week absence.

Ajay Mitchell is starting for an Oklahoma City team missing Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, and he played 28 minutes on 11/10. The show said nobody is coming to take his role soon because the Thunder are so injured.
Mitchell missed the game with an ankle sprain. The show called it a day-to-day injury and hopes he returns in the next game or two.

Ajay Mitchell is questionable with a left ankle sprain, and Oklahoma City is still without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams at the Clippers. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has scored 26 to 31 points in each of his last four games.
Al Horford sat Monday, Nov. 2, for rest on the second night of a back-to-back, not an injury, and is available Thursday.
Al Horford started over Gui Santos and played 21 minutes, which moved Draymond Green to power forward. Charles Bassey played 13 minutes with seven points and six rebounds.

Caruso returned on Nov. 4 after missing four games and played 20 minutes off the bench with seven points. The show said he should carve out his own role with Cason Wallace and Jalen Williams likely out for the season and Chet Holmgren sidelined.

Alex Caruso had four total steals and two total blocks in his first five games while averaging 19.2 minutes off the bench. He scored in single digits in four of those five games, and the show said Oklahoma City keeps limiting his minutes.

Alex Caruso moved into the starting lineup with Ajay Mitchell out and played 29 minutes on a back-to-back for 14 points, seven rebounds, three steals, and four threes. Kenrich Williams went to the bench. The show said Ajay Mitchell's ankle injury may not be significant, and Mitchell and Jalen Williams will cut into Caruso's role when they return.
Alex Morales played 29 minutes off the bench Tuesday at Sacramento with Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac and Tristan da Silva all out.
Alex Morales, a two-way player, made his first NBA start after Jamal Cain was injured. He played 18 minutes and scored five points. Jase Richardson stayed on the bench for 20 minutes.
He is questionable with left knee soreness, and Deandre Ayton started at center in his place Monday and played 24 minutes.

With Anthony Davis out on November 6, Deandre Ayton started at center, but Alex Sarr played 30 minutes and posted 13 points, 8 rebounds, 3 assists, 2 steals and 2 blocks. The show said Sarr became the de facto big man because Ayton is not very good, and it noted that his line came specifically because Davis sat.

The show said Sarr's usage rate has dropped from about 25 to 16 and his minutes from 27 to about 25 per game with Anthony Davis now in Washington. The show also said his blocks are down from two per game to about one. He had a 3-point game in 29 minutes on October 30 and then missed Washington's November 2 game, which the show suggested may mean he was playing through something.

Alex Sarr had 4 points and 8 rebounds in 25 minutes on Monday after Anthony Davis came back. He had posted 13 and 8 and then 15 and 14 in the two games Davis missed on November 6 and 7. The show said he will probably have more quiet games than good ones while Davis plays.
Alex Sarr started but played only 25 minutes for five points and eight rebounds. The show said Sarr is only good when Anthony Davis is out and is not even playing starter minutes.

Alex Sarr scored 30 points on 14 shots in 44 minutes with 9 rebounds in the double-overtime loss to Detroit. The show said it was his best game of the season and maybe of his career, and it said he made 4 of 6 threes.

Alijah Martin had a career game with 27 points, 6 threes, 2 steals and a block in 31 minutes off the bench. He had not played more than 16 minutes in any earlier game this season. The show said it does not buy the performance unless Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley stay out.
Rookie Allen Graves scored a career-high 13 points in 18 minutes off the bench Wednesday against Boston.
He sat Wednesday with low back soreness, and Steven Adams (calf) and Marcus Smart (forearm) were also out. Fred VanVleet scored 24 as Houston moved to 5-0.
Alperen Sengun is questionable tonight at Dallas with low back soreness after sitting Wednesday. Fred VanVleet scored 24 with Sengun out and is off the report for the first night of a back-to-back.
He missed Friday with low back soreness, and Clint Capela started at center with 11 rebounds and five assists in 30 minutes. Houston has not posted its injury report for Saturday yet.
Alperen Sengun had 20 points, 12 rebounds and 8 assists in 35 minutes. The show said his minutes are back to a good level.

Alperen Sengun had 19 points, 13 rebounds and 9 assists for 53.75 DK points in 37 minutes on Nov. 11. The show said Utah does not give up spot-up looks and called Sengun, Kevin Durant and Amen Thompson good tournament plays on Nov. 13.

The show said Alperen Sengun has an easy matchup on Nov 13 because Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, leaving Mo Bamba and Jaxson Hayes to guard him. Houston's own centers Clint Capela and Steven Adams are still out.

Houston is without Clint Capela and Steven Adams, and Marcus Smart is serving a league suspension. Alperen Sengun has played 35 to 39 minutes in three of his last four games, but Houston is a 17.5-point favorite over a Utah team missing Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.
Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama at the rim to win Houston's game against San Antonio on Oct. 23. He had 20 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks.

Amen Thompson played 32 minutes on Wednesday with 11 points and one assist, after playing 28 and 25 minutes in his two previous games. The show said his assists are down and his minutes are lower than last season.

Amen Thompson is averaging 32.6 minutes after leading the league in minutes last season, and the show said his per-36 production is nearly the same. The show said his assist rate is down with more offense running through Alperen Sengun and Fred VanVleet back, and his block rate has been cut in half.

Amen Thompson had 17 points, 7 rebounds, and 4 blocks in 39 minutes on November 7, but he had zero assists. The show said his assists have fallen off and his defensive numbers have not jumped up yet. He followed that with 8 points, 9 rebounds, and 3 assists in 35 minutes on November 9.

Amen Thompson had 8 points, 9 rebounds and 3 assists in 35 minutes on Monday. The show said Alperen Sengun, Fred VanVleet and Kevin Durant handle much of the ball, so it expects a quieter season from Thompson.

Amen Thompson is averaging about 33 minutes and 3.0 assists this season. The show said that is down from 37 minutes and 5.3 assists last season, when Fred VanVleet was hurt and Houston lacked a point guard. The show said VanVleet's return is the main reason for the dip.
Amen Thompson had 19 points, seven rebounds, four assists, and two blocks in 29 minutes. The show said it still wants more playing time for him, but the game was not close late.
Andre Drummond grabbed 14 rebounds in 16 minutes off the bench Tuesday against Milwaukee.

Andre Drummond has played 12 to 16 minutes off the bench in each of his last six games. The show said he can produce 30 fantasy points in 18 minutes but is only a large-field tournament dart, especially if Cup-game minutes tighten.

Andrew Nembhard played 31 minutes with 9 points and 8 assists as a starter on November 7. The show said he is playing heavy minutes and getting assists while Haliburton is out, but his efficiency and assist pace are likely to cool.
Andrew Nembhard has started every game with Tyrese Haliburton out since 10/26, and he played 34 minutes with 12 assists on 11/09. The show said his steals are low for a guard.

Andrew Nembhard has played 34 minutes in each of Indiana's last two games with Tyrese Haliburton out, posting 12 and 10 assists. The show said Indiana is running him out for a lot of minutes and called him playable at $7,000.

Andrew Wiggins came off the bench for 32 minutes on Nov. 8 and 19 minutes on Nov. 10. The show said Pelle Larsson and Klay Thompson are questionable for Nov. 13, and if both sit, Wiggins, Bobby Portis, Tim Hardaway Jr. and Ryan Conwell would get more minutes.

Andrew Wiggins started Miami's games through November 5 but came off the bench on November 8 and November 10 when Pelle Larsson started. The show said his usage has fallen sharply and that he may need to get going with Larsson doubtful, and it was unsure whether Wiggins would start on November 13.

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope was in Philadelphia's rotation ahead of Anfernee Simons on November 10 and scored 0 points in 16 minutes. Simons scored 17 points in 18 minutes, which the show called his first big game in a long time.

Anfernee Simons scored 17 points in 23 minutes off the bench with five threes against Toronto. He and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope combined for 28 bench points, and the show said the pair made 8 of 11 threes.

The show said Anthony Black's production is boosted while Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs are out. Black is averaging 16.5 points, 4.8 rebounds and 4.8 assists with about 33.4 DraftKings points per game, including 31 and 33 minutes in his last two games.
Anthony Black started for Orlando on Nov. 5 and had 10 points, seven rebounds and six assists in 31 minutes. He has started four of his five games this season while Jalen Suggs is out.

Anthony Black scored 26 points with seven rebounds, five assists and four steals in 33 minutes while Jalen Suggs and Paolo Banchero were out. The show said his role will get much smaller when Suggs and Banchero return.
Anthony Black posted 18 points, eight rebounds and six assists in 38 minutes on Nov. 7. The show said he is a strong rebounder who attacks the rim and produces whenever he stays out of foul trouble.

Anthony Black scored 51, 49.25 and 44.75 DraftKings points over his last three games while playing 38, 33 and 39 minutes with Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs out. The show said a Suggs return would push Black back toward a lower-usage role, which makes his $7,200 salary harder to trust.
He missed Friday with his ankle sprain, and the show doubts he plays both games of the back-to-back that continues Saturday at Oklahoma City.

He has missed two straight games with his ankle sprain and is questionable again at Detroit. Kyshawn George scored 33 and 38.25 DK points in the two games without him, and the show expects George to be the most popular play if Davis sits.

Davis scored 44 points with 13 rebounds in 34 minutes against Detroit on Nov. 9. The show said he dominated John Collins inside and wondered if Detroit would go back to a bigger lineup with Paul Reed. Detroit kept Jenkins in the starting lineup for the Nov. 12 rematch, where Davis scored 30 points with 15 rebounds in 44 minutes.
Anthony Davis had 21 points and 13 rebounds in 34 minutes Wednesday, and Washington hosts Detroit on the second night of a back-to-back. The Wizards have not posted their injury report yet.
Anthony Davis had 30 points and 15 rebounds in 44 minutes against Detroit before fouling out, according to the show. The game went to double overtime, which helped his minutes.

Anthony Edwards is out again after knee surgery, and Donte DiVincenzo is also out. Ayo Dosunmu has started and played 30 to 39 minutes in each of his last six games, and LaMelo Ball has scored 20 or more in three straight.

The show said Anthony Edwards is still out after knee surgery, and his last game was Minnesota's overtime loss in Cleveland. The show said the Wolves have gone 6-2 without him and have the league's best defense.

Ausar Thompson played 34 minutes on Nov. 4 with 11 points and 17 rebounds, and he played 33 minutes on opening night. The show said his minutes are up about two per game from last season, though he played only 26 minutes in two lopsided games.

Thompson started but played only 24 minutes on Nov. 8 while Daniss Jenkins was hot, finishing with 7 points and 11 rebounds. The show said he is good whenever he gets extended minutes but often loses time to foul trouble and blowouts.
Ausar Thompson had 8 points, 5 rebounds, 4 assists, 2 steals and 1 block in 28 minutes. The show said he still is not scoring and has been somewhat underwhelming this season.

The show said Ausar Thompson's assists have dropped because he now plays next to Cade Cunningham and Daniss Jenkins and has the ball in his hands less. The show said his teammates are better DFS values at his price.

Ausar Thompson posted a triple-double of 17 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists in 43 minutes against Washington. Jalen Duren was out, and the show called Thompson Cunningham's sidekick and a franchise cornerstone.

With Luka Doncic out, Austin Reaves scored 43 points in 37 minutes in a road win at Detroit. The show said the Lakers used extra screens to get Reaves switches away from Ausar Thompson. Reaves was later ruled out for the November 9 game with an illness.

Austin Reaves returned and replaced Ziaire Williams in the starting lineup, but he left after 25 minutes with a heel injury. The show said the Lakers are not worried about his Achilles, he will have more imaging, and he might miss a little time. He had 18 points, five assists, and three steals before leaving.
Ayo Dosunmu started and scored 26 points in 39 minutes Friday at New Orleans.

Anthony Edwards has not played since 10/26, and Ayo Dosunmu has started and logged 30 to 39 minutes in each of his last six games. He scored 26 points in 30 minutes on 11/08 with four threes. The show said he has been one of the best fantasy players in the league since Edwards went down, but that the role will not last once Edwards returns.
Ayo Dosunmu started and scored 18 points Thursday, but played only 27 minutes because Minnesota led Dallas by as many as 44.

With Isaiah Jackson out on Nov. 8, Miller played 20 minutes off the bench and posted 12 points, five rebounds, four assists, two steals and two blocks. The show said he is the deep-league backup center option if Jackson misses again.

Miller has moved into a real bench role with 20 minutes and 12 points on Nov. 8 and 16 minutes and 13 points on Nov. 10, after playing 12 or fewer minutes in each prior game. The show called him impressive and is watching how the Clippers find minutes for him.
Adebayo had 18 points and 10 rebounds in 33 minutes on Thursday at Golden State. The show said his usage is much lower this season and that he has cut down on three-point attempts.
Bam Adebayo played 34 minutes on Nov. 8 and 37 minutes on Nov. 10. The show said he was awful to start the season but has picked it up while playing huge minutes, and it called him fairly priced.

Baylor Scheierman started in Boston's rotating fifth starter spot and played 29 minutes with nine points, seven rebounds, three threes, two steals, and a block. The show said Boston should give him more starts over Jordan Walsh and that he is worth a look in 14-team leagues when a starter sits.
Ben Sheppard is having surgery Wednesday to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee.
Ben Simmons is out for the season.
Mathurin played only 7 minutes on Nov 6 and has not topped 19 minutes in his last four games. The show said New Orleans has too many players for him to get steady minutes.
The show said Stirtz started the second half for the Thunder on Nov. 4. He played 22 minutes off the bench with 16 points and four threes.

The rookie has averaged about 22 minutes and 12 points from Oct. 29 through Nov. 10, and the show said Oklahoma City is using him more than most people expected. The show said the addition of Nique Clifford and the eventual return of Jalen Williams will cut into his minutes.

Washington started Deandre Ayton on Nov. 6 and then started Coulibaly over Ayton on Nov. 7, when Ayton played only 7 minutes. Neither move worked, since Coulibaly scored 0 points on Nov. 7 and the show called both games horrendous.
Bilal Coulibaly returned on Nov. 11 after missing Nov. 9 and played 25 minutes off the bench. The show said he is off the injury report and offers steals, blocks and a few assists.
The Clippers signed Blake Wesley to a 10-day contract using a hardship exception because of their injuries.
Bobby Portis is playing a bench role for Miami, but his minutes have dipped from 24 on October 26 to 18 on Monday.

Bobby Portis played 21 to 27 bench minutes in most early games, but he has played 17 or 18 minutes in his last three. He scored 25.5 DraftKings points with 10 rebounds and 5 assists in 18 minutes Wednesday.
Portis played 14 minutes Thursday and went scoreless with 5 rebounds. The show said he was playing about 24 minutes a night early in the season.
Bobby Portis has played 20 minutes or fewer off the bench in recent games after getting about 24 minutes early in the season. The show said Erik Spoelstra has cut his role.
Bones Hyland has not played more than 20 minutes in any of his last four games, but he scored at least 22.75 DraftKings points in three of them.
Bones Hyland scored 14 points in 13 minutes off the bench Sunday against Utah.
Bones Hyland led Minnesota with 24 points and 8 assists in 23 minutes off the bench against Dallas. The show said he had a huge first quarter and also played in garbage time.
Braden Smith started on November 7 but played only 12 minutes, while Kelly Oubre Jr. came off the bench for 16 minutes. The show said it is unclear whether Smith holds onto the starting spot.
Braden Smith started again for Indiana but did not start the second half and played only 10 minutes. The show said he did not appear to play in the second half.
Braden Smith started on Nov 7 and Nov 9 but played only 12 and 10 minutes and scored zero points in both games. The show said he started the first half on Nov 9 and did not play again.
Bradley Beal (knee) has not played yet this season and is still recovering.
The show said Branden Carlson or Micah Potter would be Portland's backup center if Robert Williams III sits, not Yang Hansen.

Brandin Podziemski played 37 minutes and scored 22 points after Stephen Curry left early. The show said Podziemski can step up without Curry but that relying on him to carry the offense consistently would be a mistake.

Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Bradley Beal are out again for the Clippers. Darius Garland is playing through a back issue, and Keaton Wagler has played 25 to 28 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games.

The show said Brandon Ingram appears to be returning relatively soon. It expects his return to make Rui Hachimura close to irrelevant, cut into Kris Dunn's role, take some touches from Darius Garland, and make it harder for Keaton Wagler to produce.

The show said Miller ranks sixth in the NBA in usage rate and has taken at least 10 threes in all eight games, but he is hitting only about 29% of them. He scored 34, 39 and 31 points in a three-game stretch from Oct. 24 to Oct. 28, but has scored 19, 24 and 17 since.
Brandon Miller played only 26 minutes Wednesday at Brooklyn, down from about 35 a game, and scored 10 points.

The show said Brooklyn doubled Brandon Miller in the season opener and expects aggressive coverage on him Wednesday. It also said Detroit blitzed him on November 2, when he scored 17 points in 31 minutes.

The show said Miller's usage, on-ball rate, and potential assists are all up this season. The show said his shooting is well below his expected numbers and should improve, even though he is not a great shooter.

He is out Monday with a hip strain, Kon Knueppel is out at least four more weeks and Dennis Schroder is out at least two weeks. Moussa Diabate is questionable, and the show named Hannes Steinbach as the fill-in if he sits.

Brandon Miller, Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder are all out at Phoenix, while Moussa Diabate and Grant Williams are probable. Sion James and Grayson Allen started Monday, and Allen scored 27 points with six threes.
Williams played 21 minutes Thursday, more than De'Anthony Melton's 17. He had 10 points, 4 assists and 2 blocks.
An MRI showed a mild left hamstring strain for Brandon Williams, who is out at least one week and will be re-evaluated next week.

Brandon Williams has a mild left hamstring strain and is out at least a week. Golden State is also without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Gary Payton II at Houston, which is missing Clint Capela and Steven Adams.

Brayden Burries has started at point guard for Milwaukee in each of the last three games, beginning Nov. 2, while Ryan Rollins moved to the bench. On Nov. 6 he played 38 minutes and posted 21 points, 11 rebounds, six assists, and a block. The show said Burries should keep the opportunity as long as he stays a starter, though it expects the production to be uneven like most rookie point guards.

Brayden Burries has started every Bucks game since Nov. 2 after coming off the bench earlier in the season. He posted 21 points, 11 rebounds, and six assists in 38 minutes on Nov. 6, and he followed with 13 points and eight rebounds in 29 minutes on Nov. 8. The show said the rebuilding Bucks have no reason to take the rookie out of the starting lineup.

Brayden Burries has started five straight Bucks games, playing 26, 22, 38, 29 and 26 minutes from November 2 through November 10. He had a poor night on November 10 with 3 points and 3 assists in 26 minutes, but he posted 21 points and 11 rebounds on November 6. The show said he is a strong rebounder for a guard and preferred him over Kingston Flemings because he has a clearer path to 26 to 30 minutes.
Brayden Burries started on Nov. 10 and Nov. 11, playing 26 and 23 minutes. The show said he should play 25 to 28 minutes and that his $5,500 price is now about where it should be.
Brice Sensabaugh scored 19 points in 23 minutes off the bench on Nov. 11. The show called him playable for value at $4,400 on Nov. 13.

Brook Lopez has started three straight games and scored 12, 20 and 20 points in them, including 20 points and seven rebounds in 26 minutes on November 8. Isaiah Jackson was out for this game, so the Clippers had no traditional backup center. The show said Lopez is rebounding more than usual because Darius Garland does not chase rebounds, and it called him a top 80 type player while he starts.
Brook Lopez started at center again for the Clippers but played only 19 minutes in a blowout loss. The show said he remains worth holding as long as he keeps the starting center job.
Bryce Hopkins played 28 minutes off the bench with DeMar DeRozan out on Wednesday and had 18 points. The show said Nikola Jokic praised him after the game.

Cade Cunningham played only 27 minutes on Nov 9 with 17 points and 7 assists, and the show said he was in foul trouble. The show said Daniss Jenkins is a ball-dominant facilitator, and his move into the starting lineup takes a little away from Cunningham.

The show said Cade Cunningham carries about a 30% usage rate and a 38% assist rate this season with about 56.5% true shooting. It projected him at about 51 DK points on 11/12 and called him the best stud play on the slate even though Washington plays at a slow pace.

Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points with 11 assists and no turnovers in 48 minutes as Detroit won 144-140 in double overtime at Washington on Thursday. He shot 16 of 25 from the field and 17 of 18 at the line for 81.75 DraftKings points.

Martin started for Dallas on November 6 but played only 11 minutes and scored 0 points. The show called the Dallas frontcourt rotation among Santi Aldama, Daniel Gafford, Morez Johnson Jr. and Martin confusing.

Martin has been starting for Dallas, but he scored 0 points in 11 minutes on Nov. 6 and 2 points in 19 minutes on Nov. 8. The show suggested Santi Aldama could take that starting spot later in the year.
Caleb Wilson played only 22 minutes in Wednesday's blowout loss. The show said this was the first blowout in which Chicago cut his minutes.

Caleb Wilson has averaged 32.5 minutes over Chicago's eight games, and the show noted that the Bulls keep giving him big minutes even in blowout losses. His lowest total was 22 minutes in the Nov. 4 game.
The show said Caleb Wilson has a usage rate of about 26 percent, which it said has cut into the usage of everyone else on the Bulls.

The show said Caleb Wilson will be out for a month or more with a broken hand, and it noted he has broken a hand before. His last game in the box scores was Nov 11, when he played 15 minutes and scored 15 points.
Cam Johnson was out on Oct. 28 and is expected to return fairly soon.
Ty Jerome and Scotty Pippen Jr. are both questionable Saturday against Sacramento. Spencer has moved ahead of Pippen in the rotation and had eight assists in 23 minutes Thursday.
Cam Spencer has seen more playmaking work with Scotty Pippen Jr. out, including 13 assists in a start on October 31. The show said he becomes a strong option whenever Ty Jerome or Pippen misses time.
Cam Spencer had nine assists in 24 minutes off the bench on Wednesday while getting extra backup point guard work with Scotty Pippen Jr. out.

Cam Spencer played 19 minutes off the bench on November 6. The show said he is mainly a fill-in when Ty Jerome sits on back-to-backs, and it said Memphis has its next back-to-back on November 13 and 14.

Boozer had 22 points, seven rebounds and eight assists in 33 minutes on Nov. 9 for 41.75 DraftKings points. He made no threes in either of his last two games. The show said he goes through rookie swings but keeps filling the stat sheet.
With Isaiah Stewart out, rookie Cameron Boozer has played a lot of center for Memphis.

Cameron Boozer played 33 minutes, Ty Jerome played 32, Jaylen Wells played 31 and Cedric Coward played 27 on Nov. 11. The show said it likes Boozer, Jerome and Coward on Nov. 13 but does not want Wells at ownership.

The show said Cameron Boozer has been an excellent fantasy-points-per-minute player who is showing everything he did in college. The show said Boozer could take rebounds and easy rim shots from Isaiah Stewart with Zach Edey out, but it still likes playing them together.
Cameron Carr made his debut Sunday and played 1 minute late in the game without scoring.

Cameron Johnson got hurt in the opener and played only 11 minutes on Oct. 22. Since returning he has played 34, 34, and 30 minutes in his first three games back, all starts, and he added 29 minutes with 18 points on Nov. 7. The show said he has the skill set to be Denver's third option behind Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray, and it noted he is playing for a new contract.
Cameron Johnson started and scored 18 points with 4 rebounds, a steal and two threes in 29 minutes. The show said he has looked involved since returning from his early-season injury.

Cameron Johnson has started and played 29 to 34 minutes in each of his last four games. He has averaged a little over 12 points in that stretch. The show said he is close to being a must-roster player.
Cameron Johnson scored 23 points with four threes in 30 minutes. The show called it his first big game of the season and said his hot shooting makes it somewhat fake.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.

Coward took only six shots and scored three points on Nov. 9, though he still reached 23 DraftKings points. The show said his low shot volume makes his scoring risky, but his all-around stats give him a decent floor.
Cedric Coward scored only 3 points on Monday but added 2 steals and a block in 28 minutes. The show said his steals and rebounds have been high this season, but it expects both to come down.

Cedric Coward had 15 points and 11 rebounds in 27 minutes on Nov. 11 and has at least nine rebounds in four of his last six games. The show liked him at $5,900 against a fast-paced New Orleans defense.
Chaney Johnson has started Brooklyn's last five games, but he played only nine minutes on Wednesday. The show expects him to start again.
Charles Bassey played 14 minutes off the bench on Thursday with Gui Santos out and had eight points, seven rebounds and three blocks.
Charles Bassey played 11 minutes off the bench on November 7. The show said he would only be useful in a game where he is known to get about 20 minutes, which cannot be predicted.

Charles Bassey's minutes have climbed to 20, 23, 14, 11 and 18 over the five Warriors games from November 1 through November 9, after he played only 2 to 9 minutes in earlier games. The show said there is a center role for him with Kristaps Porzingis out, since Draymond Green and Al Horford do not play big minutes there.
